page_title: Bardeen: Find and reach leads no one else can.

summary.name: Bardeen
summary.one_liner: Bardeen is an AI automation and workflow platform for GTM teams that scrapes leads from the web, qualifies them with AI, and enriches contact details for outreach.
use_cases: build a targeted lead list for an industry
scrape real estate listings and enrich agent contacts
find emerging music artists from blogs and charts
automate sales outreach and lead enrichment
update CRM data and automate sales workflows
summary.what_it_does: Bardeen uses an agentic web scraper to source leads from websites, blogs, charts, socials and listings. It qualifies those leads with AI and enriches them with contact information for outreach. Results can be exported to CSV, Google Sheets, Airtable or Notion. The page also describes it as a broader workflow platform that connects to CRMs, communication, lead generation and project tools to automate repetitive GTM tasks. It lists scraper templates and industry-specific pages for solopreneurs, real estate and music.
notable: Agentic web scraper that sources leads from the open web
AI lead qualification combined with contact enrichment
Exports to CSV, Google Sheets, Airtable and Notion
Claims SOC 2 Type II, GDPR and CASA Tier 2 and 3 certification
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page
Page positions itself against Clay-level budgets, implying cost-sensitivity; actual plan costs are not listed
